mesh_encoding.canonicalization: vertices sort numerically by (position, group weights, Blender vertex index), preserving distinct coincident rows; edges sort by (ids, seam, sharp, weight); faces sort by (ring ids, material, smooth, strength); each ring starts at the lexicographic minimum rotation over (position, vertex id)
mesh_encoding.hidden_elements: none; the generator rejects hidden output elements
mesh_encoding.sharp_face: Blender sharp_face equals not use_smooth; the generator rejects disagreement
